# Boundless Brainstorm — Every Public Revelation Becomes Searchable

The Awtsmoos recreates every public word in every instant, and Awtsmoos.com should not hide that light behind a JavaScript veil;
comments, translations, aliases, games, apps, Torah, tools, and public pages must leave a semantic trail.

## Mission universe

- Every public Heichel and series.
- Every public post and Road route.
- Every public comment and nested reply, including translated/English rendering where public data supplies it.
- Every public alias profile and alias display name.
- Every public Awtsmoos app landing page.
- Every public game and game landing page.
- Every ordinary public content page currently reachable through Awtsmoos navigation.
- Every canonical URL should provide meaningful title, description, H1/body/link semantics without depending on client JavaScript.
- Search discovery must be scalable: sitemap indexes/seed maps where appropriate, ordinary HTML links for depth, and no synchronous whole-database recursion.
- Private, draft, editor, admin, action-only, API-only, authenticated, destructive, ephemeral, and internal routes must not be indexed.

## Architectural possibilities

1. One giant root sitemap enumerating every URL.
2. Sitemap index split by surface family.
3. Generated static sitemap shards during release.
4. Dynamic family sitemaps backed by bounded direct datastore reads.
5. Search-index-driven sitemap exports.
6. Semantic server-rendered discovery hubs plus bounded sitemaps.
7. Canonical resource pages for comments/replies where no stable page exists today.
8. Server-render comments inside their parent post only, with fragment anchors.
9. Hybrid: canonical comment anchors on parent pages + optional dedicated comment routes only where already supported.
10. App/game registry-based sitemap generation from actual route/catalog sources.

The winning architecture should combine stable public route catalogs, bounded family sitemaps, semantic SSR, and crawlable HTML graph edges.
